text:

17-PELRB-2026
STATE OF NEW MEXICO
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE LABOR RELATIONS BOARD
In re:
SIX DIRECTIONS UNITED EDUCATORS,
Petitioner,
and PELRB No. 302-26
SIX DIRECTIONS INDIGENOUS SCHOOL,
Respondent.
ORDER
THIS MATTER comes before the Public Employee Labor Relations Board at its regularly
scheduled meeting on June 2, 2026, upon the Petition filed January 8, 2026, to Certify the
Petitioner as the exclusive representative of a bargaining unit consisting of employees of Six
directions Indigenous School holding the positions of Administrative Assistant, Custodian, Full-
Time Sub, IT Specialist, Math Teacher, Navajo Language Teacher, Navajo Language Educational
Assistant (EA), Programs Coordinator, Teacher/Educator, and Zuni Language Teacher. The
Board, having reviewed the file, and being otherwise sufficiently informed, finds and concludes:
The Petition does not raise a question concerning representation and it presents sufficient facts
including sufficient support among the employees in the petitioned-for positions to be represented
by Petitioner pursuant to NMAC 11.21.2.33.
Upon review of the submissions and no one appearing in opposition to the Certification, the
Board by a vote of 3-0 hereby affirms and ratifies the Certification of Representation issued by the
Executive Director on May 26, 2026, including the findings therein..
6/9/2026
_____________________________________ Date:_______________
Nan Nash, Board Chair
